description: A rectangular rug featuring a geometric pattern composed of interlocking triangles. The triangles are rendered in various shades of blue, grey, and red, creating a dynamic and modern aesthetic. The rug appears to have a low pile and a textured surface, suggesting it is made of fabric. The edges of the rug are finished with a subtle, lighter colored trim. The overall design is abstract and visually engaging, suitable for adding a touch of contemporary style to a space.
